scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced

rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → builds with stale/wrong config → output in wrong path

scenarios.reasoning: The agent did a good job identifying the build failure, listing all projects built, and determining that LrgWindowsAppManifest was not built. The approach was efficient with only 7 tool calls and no errors (the bash failure was handled gracefully). The configuration analysis could have been deeper - it correctly identified Release|x64 as the configuration but didn't fully explore configuration mismatches as a potential root cause. Overall a solid analysis that answers the user's questions well.
